image_description: A still life composition featuring three white ceramic coffee cups on saucers arranged on a wooden table. One cup is upright in the center, one is tipped over on its side to the right, and one is upright in the background. Scattered coffee beans surround the cups. To the left, there are decorative elements including a pinecone, acorns, and a burlap sack. In the background, out-of-focus glass containers are visible. Text at the bottom reads 'Cups And Beans' and 'project26c • photography'.
